segments.title: Willy's Chocolate Experience LA Email & Vault Overseer Sign-On
segments.notes: Case reads a surreal email from House of Illuminati LA about a Willy Wonka-themed warehouse event, then transitions into Fallout 4 roleplay as Overseer Blackwell.

segments.title: Fallout 4 Wasteland Expedition: Trinity Tower to Saugus Ironworks
segments.notes: Case roleplays as Chet Manscape navigating the Commonwealth, completing Minutemen quests, acquiring the Searing Shish Kebab flaming sword, and liberating Breakheart Banks for a ghoul settlement while managing an irradiated dog companion.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the broadcast as Overseer Blackwell, roleplaying a Fallout 4 playthrough as science-axe wielder Chet Manscape while reading viewer mail and managing chat.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appears on mic to announce she is returning to bed and work, prompting Case to hide her from the stream.

episode_summary: Overseer Blackwell inaugurates a vault-dweller side hustle by reading a chaotic Willy's Chocolate Experience email before embarking on a marathon Fallout 4 session as axe-specialist Chet Manscape. The expedition clears Trinity Tower, recovers a family heirloom flaming sword from the Forged at Saugus Ironworks, and secures Breakheart Banks for a ghoul settlement, all while managing an irradiated dog companion and a chat-driven sub goal for Hype Train.
